name: [CH] Endpoint Apps - Bluetooth [is]
description: Intent: [CH] Cyberhaven-curated Bluetooth app names — OS-level Bluetooth managers and file-transfer apps (BlueSoleil, Windows Bluetooth Service, Android Bluetooth Stack, etc.). Drives the Bluetooth-category sub-segmentation on M5010 (Endpoint App Activity - Bluetooth) under the M5000 umbrella. Curated baseline — extend with bespoke Bluetooth tooling if your environment uses it. Exclusions: do not remove curated entries; do not add BLE headphones / personal wearables (those are infrastructure, not exfil vectors).
